THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I , Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

An allotment of land depicted in below name and extent in the Advance Tracing No. MN/MNN/2023/554 dated 25.10.2023 prepared by the Surveyor General situated in the village called Kaddukarankudiyiruppu in the Grama Niladhari Division No. MN/53 of Kaddukaran Kudiyiruppu in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Mannar Town of Mannar District in Northern Province and bounded as follow.
01. Lot 'A' – Kaddukarankudiyiruppukaani – Extent: 1.0641 Hectare North, East, South and West: Kaddukarankudiyiruppukaani (claimant not known) .
Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
My Ref. No.: 4 -3/11/2023/RE/202.Ministry of Tourism and Lands,"Mihikatha Medura", Rajamalwatta Avenue,Battaramulla.01st February, 2024
